title: Export the definition for `list of the descendant browsing contexts`
body:
Export the definition for [`list of the descendant browsing contexts`](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#list-of-the-descendant-browsing-contexts) so that the [screen orientation spec](https://w3c.github.io/screen-orientation/) can better [reference](https://github.com/w3c/screen-orientation/blob/gh-pages/index.html#L1153-L1156) it.

cc @marcoscaceres
